talks.excerpt: Among the words of the English language the word farewell is the hardest to pronounce, and I, probably, will succeed very poorly at my present attempt.

talks.title: History of the Academy
talks.speaker: Karl G. Maeser
talks.excerpt: Amid the ever-changing scenes of development . . . there must go through it all, like a golden thread, one thing constant: the spirit of the latter-day work.
